stage: Historical Markov transitions and hindcast baseline
interpretation: Transition probabilities and expected class areas are derived from model-classified historical maps. Spatial CA allocation is not included.
limitations: Large class reversals may represent apparent rather than genuine land-cover change.
The 2025 comparison is a classified map, not independent ground truth.
The historical classifier was developed using reference samples from 2015, 2020 and 2025.
A Markov model assumes historical transition behaviour is informative for the next interval.
The persistence benchmark predicts no changes.
No cellular automata allocation was performed.
